TGI Fridays Happy Hour: Get More for Less with Great Food and Drink Offers

Looking for a fantastic way to enjoy great food and drinks at affordable prices? TGI Fridays Happy Hour offers exactly that, with an extensive menu of delicious appetizers, premium cocktails, and more at special discounted rates. Whether you’re stopping by after work or planning a casual get-together with friends, TGI Fridays delivers a vibrant atmosphere filled with incredible deals and flavors. In this detailed guide, we’ll explore the offerings, pricing, locations, and everything else you need to know about TGI Fridays Happy Hour in 2024, including popular locations like Atlanta and their iconic bar experience.

A Brief History of TGI Fridays

Founded in 1965, TGI Fridays opened its doors in Manhattan, introducing what became an iconic American bar and restaurant experience. The original TGI Fridays was the go-to spot for a great time, offering delicious food and drinks in a laid-back atmosphere. Over the years, the brand has expanded globally, maintaining its core value of bringing people together over great meals and exciting drinks.

Now, in 2024, TGI Fridays continues to serve as one of America’s most iconic bars, offering the perfect setting for both casual dining and lively happy hour gatherings.

TGI Fridays Happy Hour: What to Expect

TGI Fridays Happy Hour offers some of the best deals you can find at a restaurant. It’s not just about getting drinks for a great price—you can also indulge in a variety of appetizers and entrees at discounted rates. The happy hour timings may vary depending on the location, but typically run during the late afternoon into the evening.

Happy Hour Timings

  • Monday to Friday: 4:00 PM – 7:00 PM
  • Late-Night Happy Hour: Varies by location (check with your nearest restaurant)

What’s on the Happy Hour Menu?

The TGI Fridays Happy Hour Menu is packed with customer favorites, including items like whiskey-glazed burgers, chicken wings, and their iconic ribs. You’ll also find discounted cocktails, beers, and other alcoholic beverages.

Drinks Menu

During happy hour, TGI Fridays offers discounted cocktails like the Bloody Mary, Long Island Iced Tea, and a variety of premium cocktail selections. Whether you prefer a classic drink or something with a creative twist, there’s something for everyone. Non-alcoholic beverages are also available for those who prefer to drink responsibly.

Appetizers and Small Plates

To pair with your drinks, TGI Fridays offers a selection of appetizers at happy hour pricing. These small plates are perfect for sharing with friends or enjoying as a snack alongside your favorite cocktail. Popular options include:

Appetizer Description Happy Hour Price
Chicken Wings Available with a variety of sauces, including Buffalo and BBQ. $6
Mozzarella Sticks Crispy on the outside, gooey cheese on the inside, served with marinara sauce. $5
Loaded Potato Skins Topped with melted cheese, bacon, and green onions, served with sour cream. $5
Boneless Wings All the flavor of wings without the bones, available in multiple flavors. $6
Fridays Sampler A mix of the best appetizers, perfect for sharing with friends. $12

Burgers, Ribs, and More

For those who want a more filling option, happy hour also includes discounts on whiskey-glazed burgers, ribs, and other signature items. TGI Fridays is known for their burgers and ribs, making them a popular choice among regulars.

Pricing and Specials During Happy Hour

While the exact prices may vary by location, the discounts during happy hour are substantial, often cutting the price of food and drinks by 30-50%. Whether you’re in Atlanta or another major city, expect affordable options without compromising on flavor.

Here’s a breakdown of typical happy hour pricing:

Item Regular Price Happy Hour Price
Classic Cocktails $12 $6
Premium Cocktails $14 $8
Beer $8 $5
Chicken Wings $10 $6
Loaded Potato Skins $9 $5
Whiskey-Glazed Burger $14 $10
Fridays Sampler $15 $12

Premium Cocktails Selections

During happy hour, you can indulge in a variety of premium cocktails that offer bold flavors and refreshing combinations. These cocktails are available at a special discounted price, making them a perfect companion to your appetizers.

Cocktail Description Happy Hour Price
Ultimate Margarita A refreshing blend of tequila, lime, and sweetened lime juice, creating the perfect balance of flavors. $8
Manhattan in 1965 A nostalgic twist on the classic Manhattan, inspired by the year TGI Fridays opened. $9
Long Island Iced Tea A mix of vodka, rum, gin, and triple sec, topped with cola for a refreshing yet powerful drink. $8

These premium cocktail selections are a must-try, offering both classic and innovative drinks that enhance your happy hour experience at TGI Fridays.

Lunch and Late-Night Happy Hour

While TGI Fridays Happy Hour is typically in the early evening, some locations offer lunch specials and a late-night happy hour, giving you more opportunities to enjoy great food at a reduced price. For exact timings, check your nearby location.

Locations: Where to Find TGI Fridays Happy Hour Near You

Whether you’re in Atlanta, Camp Creek, or anywhere else in the U.S., you can find a TGI Fridays restaurant nearby. Their happy hour offerings are consistent across locations, though the specific menu items may vary slightly.

Popular TGI Fridays Locations

TGI Fridays has locations across the U.S., each offering a welcoming atmosphere and great happy hour deals. Here are a few popular spots where you can enjoy their signature food and drink offerings:

Location Description
TGI Fridays Atlanta Located near Camp Creek Pkwy, this spot is perfect for locals and tourists alike. With a welcoming bar area and outdoor seating, it’s a great spot for happy hour.
TGI Fridays in GA With various locations throughout Georgia, you’ll find the same exciting happy hour menus and energetic vibes at each one.
TGI Fridays NYC The Manhattan location is a nod to TGI Fridays’ origins, opening in 1965. It remains a go-to spot for both locals and visitors to enjoy a nostalgic experience paired with modern drinks and food.

These locations offer consistent quality, whether you’re stopping in for a drink in Atlanta, Georgia, or New York City.

Safety and Dine-In Options at TGI Fridays

In 2024, TGI Fridays is committed to ensuring the safety of its customers. With updated safety protocols, the restaurant continues to offer a clean and secure environment for dine-in and takeout options.

Takeout and Delivery Options

If you’re looking to enjoy TGI Fridays from the comfort of your home, you can now order delivery or takeout, making it easier than ever to get your favorite food and drinks. Their delivery menu includes many of the same happy hour items, and both options provide convenient, contactless service.

Option Description
Order Delivery Available through third-party apps like DoorDash, UberEats, and more, allowing you to enjoy TGI Fridays from home.
Takeout You can also call your nearest TGI Fridays location to place a takeout order and pick it up directly.

Whether you choose delivery or takeout, you can still indulge in the same delicious happy hour offerings right from your home.

Restaurant Reviews: What People Are Saying About TGI Fridays Happy Hour

Online reviews for TGI Fridays Happy Hour are overwhelmingly positive. Customers rave about the great food, the variety on the menu, and the affordable prices.

Popular Reviews

  • “I love coming here for happy hour! The drinks are always great, and the appetizers are perfect for sharing with friends.”
  • “Their whiskey-glazed burger is to die for, especially when it’s half-price during happy hour.”
  • “TGI Fridays is still America’s most iconic bar, and their happy hour deals keep me coming back.”

TGI Fridays Favs: Signature Items You Must Try

During happy hour or any visit, there are certain TGI Fridays Favs you simply cannot miss. These items have been fan favorites for years, and continue to be must-orders.

Whiskey-Glazed Burgers

A signature item at TGI Fridays, the whiskey-glazed burger offers a perfect balance of sweet and savory flavors. It’s a juicy burger with a whiskey-glazed coating that’s become one of the restaurant’s top items.

Chicken Wings

Available in both boneless and traditional styles, TGI Fridays Chicken Wings are a customer favorite. You can choose from a variety of sauces, including Buffalo, Garlic Parmesan, and Whiskey-Glaze.

Ribs

TGI Fridays’ ribs are fall-off-the-bone tender, and the whiskey-glaze gives them a unique flavor that you won’t find at other chain restaurants.

TGI Fridays Rewards: Perks and Benefits

One of the best ways to enhance your TGI Fridays experience is by joining the Fridays Rewards program. This loyalty program allows you to accumulate points with every purchase, which you can later redeem for discounts, free menu items, and exclusive perks.

Perk Description
Free Fridays Get exclusive offers and discounts just for being a rewards member.
Perk for First-Time Members New members receive a welcome offer when they sign up, making your first visit even more rewarding.
Birthday Perks Enjoy a special treat on your birthday, like a free dessert or discounted meal.

By joining Fridays Rewards, you can take advantage of these perks and benefits every time you dine at TGI Fridays, whether you’re enjoying a casual meal or their signature happy hour.

FAQs: Everything You Need to Know About TGI Fridays Happy Hour

Here are some frequently asked questions about TGI Fridays Happy Hour:

What time is happy hour at TGI Fridays?

Typically, happy hour is from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM on weekdays, but exact times may vary depending on the location.

What’s included in the happy hour menu?

You can enjoy a wide variety of discounted cocktails, appetizers like chicken wings, burgers, and even ribs during happy hour.

Is there a late-night happy hour?

Yes, many locations offer a late-night happy hour that starts after 9:00 PM. Check with your local TGI Fridays for specific times.

Can I order happy hour items for takeout or delivery?

While takeout is available, happy hour pricing is usually limited to dine-in customers. However, many locations allow you to enjoy their menu via delivery services like DoorDash or UberEats.

What are some popular drinks during happy hour?

The Bloody Mary, Ultimate Margarita, and Long Island Iced Tea are among the most popular drinks available during happy hour.

Does TGI Fridays offer vegan or vegetarian options?

Yes, TGI Fridays offers a range of vegetarian and vegan options, including salads, sides, and even some modified burgers.

Conclusion: Why You Should Visit TGI Fridays Happy Hour

If you’re looking for a great way to enjoy delicious food and drinks at an affordable price, TGI Fridays Happy Hour is the place to be. With a wide variety of appetizers, cocktails, and entrees, there’s something for everyone. Whether you’re dining in Atlanta, Camp Creek, or another location, the vibe is always fun, and the food is always delicious. Stop by your nearest TGI Fridays today and take advantage of the fantastic happy hour deals!
